scope: Mobile layout, keyboard operation and bounded accessibility self-review of the 14-page website. Store excluded.
before: Dark feature-panel paragraph inherited brown text on blue: calculated contrast 1.39:1.
Gallery document arrow handler intercepted slide-duration select keyboard input.
Cultural-note jump forced smooth scrolling without moving keyboard focus.
Several navigation links and controls had small touch areas; captions and Odia header text were small.
Profile header overflowed by one pixel at 320 CSS pixels.
changes: Use light text on the dark feature panel, clearer focus outlines and darker form boundaries.
Provide at least 44px main-navigation and viewer controls; enlarge small reading text and 16px inputs.
Respect select/input keyboard events; keep arrow photo navigation elsewhere.
Respect reduced motion, remove hover motion and move focus to the cultural note.
Focusable skip destinations and semantic topic navigation; restore source shortcut on mobile profile.
Wrap narrow headings, improve footer layout and correct no-JavaScript photo-story description.

page_checks: One h1 and main landmark per page; every image has an alt attribute.
Viewer at 320px: no internal horizontal overflow; five controls measure 44px high.
browser_behavior: Skip to content moves focus to main.
Search for Chilika shows one entry; unmatched search shows the empty state.
Slide-duration ArrowRight changes 10 to 20 seconds without changing photo.
ArrowRight from Next photograph advances photo.
Escape closes photo viewer and returns focus to original thumbnail.
Escape closes nested sharing dialog and returns focus to Share this photograph.
Reduced-motion emulation disables image transition; cultural jump focuses its panel below the sticky controls and pauses slideshow.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation only; no physical iPhone/Android or Safari testing.
No VoiceOver/NVDA session or comprehensive WCAG conformance claim.
Alt text presence checked; semantic accuracy still requires editorial review.
One Tab from the final dialog link moved focus outside document to browser chrome; native modal behavior retained, no full browser-chrome focus-cycle certification.
Odia rendered visually; native-language proofreading remains a human review.
publication: Approved, merged and deployed; see deployment evidence below.

live_checks: HTTPS homepage has focusable main landmark and light text on blue feature panel.
No Store link on homepage; artifact exclusion tests passed in deployment.
Live gallery position has status semantics; ArrowRight on duration selector does not change the photograph.
Escape closes live viewer and returns focus to originating thumbnail.
